# chalk_cluster_container_registry_binding (Resource)

Manages a binding between a Chalk cluster and a container registry.

**Required permissions:** `project.create` *(team-scoped)*



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster to bind to the container registry.
- `container_registry_id` (String) The ID of the container registry to bind to the cluster.
